query: SELECT DISTINCT u.id, u.email AS "email!" FROM users u WHERE u.state = 'active' AND u.email IS NOT NULL AND ( u.id IN (SELECT user_id FROM project_memberships WHERE project_id = $1 AND preset = 'admin') OR u.id IN (SELECT m.user_id FROM org_memberships m JOIN projects p ON p.org_id = m.org_id WHERE p.id = $1 AND m.preset IN ('owner', 'admin'))) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification_settings s WHERE s.user_id = u.id AND s.kind = 'budget_alerts' AND s.delivery = 'off') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification_mutes n JOIN projects p ON p.org_id = n.org_id WHERE n.user_id = u.id AND p.id = $1)
